journey.name: USDT Opt In
journey.description: Use a fresh onboarded wallet with USDT services configured. The wallet has no USDT balance or pending transfers. Use owned payment links and existing requests; no payment is submitted.

actions.action: On Home, verify the New: USDT sheet (id "UsdtIntro") shows the Tether coin, DOLLARS? YOUR CALL heading, No Thanks and Enable USDT.
Swipe the intro sheet down. Verify Home shows Savings and Spending without a USDT tile. Open Receive and verify there is no USDT tab, then close it.
Terminate and relaunch the app. Verify the USDT intro returns. Tap No Thanks (id "UsdtIntroDecline"), relaunch again, and verify the intro does not return.
Open Settings, General, Payments. Verify USDT (Tether) (id "UsdtSettingsToggle") is off. Enable it, return Home, and verify the USDT tile appears. Open Receive and verify the USDT tab appears.

Open USDT Send and its network pill. Verify the USDT Network picker (id "UsdtNetworkPicker") uses rounded rows with Tether icons, a teal selection check, the recipient-network explanation and Tether coin illustration. Choose another supported network and verify the pill updates.

Return to Settings and turn USDT off while the wallet is empty and all transfers are complete. Verify the USDT tile, receive tab and new Paykit receiving option disappear. Existing payment history remains stored.

Open an owned USDT payment link while USDT is off. Verify the Enable USDT prompt (id "UsdtEnablePrompt"). Cancel and verify USDT stays off. Open the link again, enable USDT (id "UsdtEnablePromptContinue"), and verify the recipient and exact amount continue into the payment flow. Cancel without paying.

With a funded wallet or an unresolved transfer, try turning USDT off in Settings. Verify the change is blocked with an explanation and the wallet and pending payment remain accessible. Restore the original setting after this check.

Restore an owned funded wallet whose USDT preference is absent or off. Verify its USDT wallet remains visible without enabling new Paykit receiving options. Open Receive, enable USDT when asked, and verify it opens the USDT tab. No payment is submitted.
